programs.name: causal_daily_gate
programs.description: Use when low errors on both folds, with improvement from 0.0726 to 0.0539 sMAE and no execution failures, support preserving seasonal behavior but do not identify a unique failure cause; this descendant conservatively gates a level-adjusted 24-step phase forecast against a robust local fallback using three causal holdouts.
programs.assumption: The seasonal component is enabled only if it beats the local-median baseline by at least 10% on at least two of three recent 24-step causal holdouts and its worst holdout MAE ratio is at most 1.05.
programs.failure_condition: It fails observably when a new level or seasonal-phase shift occurs after the validation origins, causing the enabled seasonal forecast to have a realized MAE more than 1.05 times that of the local-median forecast.
